architecture.transputer: existing TEMDD ledger, original Work Unit and writer fencing

matched_conditions.model_and_settings: exact shared ibm/contract.json and independently observed MODEL_ADMISSION.json
matched_conditions.baseline: ordinary full transcript, saved draft, sources, persistence and normal restore retained
matched_conditions.qikvrt: same ordinary history plus actual PersonalRuntime checkpoint on explicit resume
matched_conditions.task_and_source_bytes: same frozen fixture binding within each pair
matched_conditions.pre_interruption_work: actual independently scored equivalent work; never seed model history from scoring oracles

limits.count_input_tokens: before every request, including system, full history, sources and any checkpoint
limits.unresolved_request: preserve pending intent and original Work Unit; independent readback before any successor
limits.failure_policy: retain every planned row, errors, timeouts, limits and censored observations

observer.interruption_witness: actual process exit/context loss, monotonic interval and restart on the same persistent state
observer.transputer_readback: same Work Unit/session, original event bytes and digests, no lost acknowledged or duplicate effects
observer.oracle_access: observer only; no scoring files or observer credentials in participant filesystem or tools
observer.participant_input: existing /api/task/<trial_id> view without oracle; never the private run directory
observer.independence_scope: a second identifier or local digest alone is not independent observation

raw_record_requirements: original model request/response bodies without authorization headers, their exact byte hashes and provider usage
request/session/Work Unit IDs, source bindings, pre-run and restored baseline history readback
actual interruption/restart traces, observer epoch and monotonic request/resume/completion timings
all outputs, errors, unsupported completion claims, human inputs and interventions
independent replay of scoring from frozen oracle and original outputs using a pinned parser
exact source commit/tree/file hashes; independent original-byte readback after persistence

analysis.implementation_status: existing evaluator accepts harness evidence only; real observer and output parser still required
